adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#12
adds.text: Anne Weaver calls Skye and the team to the S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy to find who is behind the freezing attacks on her cadets.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An agent who helps investigate the attacks on Weaver's cadets.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The Academy head who calls in Skye's team.
adds.evidence: Seeds (S1#12): Ward, Fitz, Simmons and Skye are sent to the Academy; Weaver greets and briefs them, with an on-screen exchange between Weaver, Ward and Skye about 'bad seeds'. Coulson and May are in Mexico City.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#15
adds.text: When Lorelei takes over the Bus, Skye helps trick her into the interrogation room, where Sif is waiting to collar her.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An Asgardian Skye helps trap Lorelei for.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who helps lure Lorelei into Sif's trap.
adds.evidence: Yes Men (S1#15): Sif hunts Lorelei with Coulson's team; Simmons and Skye trick Lorelei into the interrogation room where Sif confronts and collars her.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#9
adds.text: Agent Davis goes with Jemma and Fitz to gather readings at the wrecked StatiCorp facility.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A scientist Davis helps gather data at StatiCorp.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who helps Jemma gather data at StatiCorp.
adds.evidence: Repairs (S1#9): Fitz, Simmons and Agent James Davis head to StatiCorp to gather data with the D.W.A.R.F.s, talking along the way.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#9
adds.text: Agent Davis helps Fitz gather data at the wrecked StatiCorp facility, and Fitz orders him to pack up the gear and head back to the Bus.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An engineer Davis helps gather data at StatiCorp.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who helps Fitz gather data at StatiCorp.
adds.evidence: Repairs (S1#9): Davis assists Fitz and Simmons at StatiCorp; Fitz: 'Information data uploaded, let's get going.' Davis: 'Yes, sir.'

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#16
adds.text: Felix Blake and Jasper Sitwell board the Bus together for Coulson's meeting on hunting the Clairvoyant.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Fellow agent who boards the Bus with Blake for the Clairvoyant hunt.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Fellow agent who boards the Bus with Sitwell for the Clairvoyant hunt.
adds.evidence: End of the Beginning (S1#16): Blake and Sitwell walk aboard the Bus together, trading lines about the unconventional meeting, before Coulson's briefing on the Clairvoyant.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#20
adds.text: Glenn Talbot's soldiers hold the team at Providence, and Jemma argues that Ward is getting away with Skye while Talbot questions them.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An agent who argues with Talbot at Providence to go after Ward.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A colonel who holds Jemma's team at Providence.
adds.evidence: Nothing Personal (S1#20): Talbot questions Coulson's team at Providence; Simmons argues that Ward, a Hydra agent who took Skye, is getting away while they talk.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#20
adds.text: Hill tells May that when she asked Fury about Coulson's return, he would only say that he buried the intel when he decided not to bury Coulson.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Hill's boss, who answers her questions about Coulson with a riddle.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Fury's right hand, who gets only a riddle when she asks about Coulson.
adds.evidence: Nothing Personal (S1#20): Hill tells May she asked Fury before, but he only told her 'that he buried the intel when he decided not to bury Coulson.' Fury is not on screen with her in S1 (he appears in #2 and #22; she in #1 and #20), so this rests on her recounted exchange.
